text:
Marta G: Hey team — opened PR 4826 with a compact example for a local-bridge tunnel option for semi-airgapped Private installs. Includes WireGuard + IPsec examples, an installer yaml snippet, and a short note about MTU. Please review the network and KMS/HSM callouts.

Vikram P: Thanks Marta. Can you add the HSM port list (TCP 1792, 3630) and mention the HSM health probe timeout? We had a case where a 2s probe failed on slow links.

Marta G: good catch — added HSM ports and a paragraph that suggests probe timeout >= 5s for satellite links.

Alex R: Quick UX nit: the installer snippet uses hostNetwork: true — can we also show the alternative where the installer creates a host-local bridge for isolated hosts? Many customers ask for an explicit bridge example.

Marta G: added host-bridge example + minimal systemd drop-in to force MTU 1400 on the bridge interface (some NICs need it for tunneling).

Sam L: I validated the WireGuard example on a small VM pair. Two tiny notes: keepalive 25s worked best; and if using iptables fallback, remember to set conntrack max to avoid drop under load. I pasted the test rules below.

Sam L: ```
# WireGuard peer (minimal)
[Interface]
Address = 10.10.0.2/24
PrivateKey = (redacted)
ListenPort = 51820

[Peer]
PublicKey = (peer-key)
Endpoint = 203.0.113.5:51820
AllowedIPs = 10.10.0.0/24
PersistentKeepalive = 25
```

Sam L: ```
# systemd drop-in to set MTU on bridge0
[Service]
Environment=BRIDGE_IF=br0
ExecStartPost=/sbin/ip link set dev ${BRIDGE_IF} mtu 1400
```

Sam L: ```
# iptables fallback (nat + established)
-A POSTROUTING -s 10.10.0.0/24 -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE
-A FORWARD -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -s 10.10.0.0/24 -j ACCEPT
```

Vikram P: Can we also add a short HSM troubleshooting checklist? e.g., verify time sync, cert chain, /var/log/hsm-plugin, and a quick tcpdump example to show TLS handshake to the HSM port.

Marta G: done — added a 4-step HSM checklist and a tcpdump one-liner. Also linked to the PKCS#11 quick reference.

Alex R: Link check flagged one internal doc url as 404 — https://internal.redwood/docs/hsm-old -> update to new pkcs11 guide.

Marta G: fixed link.

docs-bot: linkcheck: 1 warning, 0 errors (checked 14 links). See CI job: https://ci.redwood/links/4826

Sam L: small suggestion for wording: in the "air-gapped bundle" section, explicitly call out the order: certs -> installer images -> offline repo tarball. Customers trip on this ordering.

Marta G: updated ordering + added a one-line checklist at top of the air-gapped section.

Alex R: LGTM from docs side once CI passes. Optional: add a tiny note on iptables vs nftables variants (we have both in field).

Marta G: added nftables snippet and a short note that distro default matters (Debian/Ubuntu vs RHEL).

Vikram P: Approving for network + HSM. Would like a follow-up tiny PR that adds an example for a hardware VPN concentrator (IPSec) — customers sometimes want that rather than WireGuard.

Marta G: filing follow-up for IPSec concentrator example after merge. Thanks all! :tada:
